    How Wheel Call works

    Squeekchain rounds are 10 minutes long. When a round ends, the hamster's work for that round is settled on chain. You call the next round before it starts: Nap (0 work), Trot (1–299), Run (300–549) or Zoomies (550+). Calls lock 10 seconds before the round begins.

    Odds are fixed when you place the call. The Oracle seals its own call at the same moment with the same stake and always takes the band it thinks is most likely. Right calls pay stake × odds. If a round can't be resolved from chain data, both stakes come back.

    Seeds are play points stored in this browser. They have no cash value.
